description: Main installer entry script for the OrangeHRM system. It performs environment checks (such as PHP version validation), initializes autoloading, configures debugging mode, and handles incoming HTTP requests via a custom kernel, returning responses or handling specific exceptions.

classes.name: HttpKernel
classes.description: Handles HTTP requests and produces responses within the OrangeHRM installer environment.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents an HTTP request, created from global PHP variables.

methods.name: trimVersion
methods.description: Trims a string version to a specified number of version points (e.g., major, minor).

methods.name: isInSupportedPHPRange
methods.description: Checks if the current PHP version is within the supported range specified in a configuration file.
